'''Paitr do Fearna a'Conn''' is a noble from [[Murandy]]. 

==Appearance==
He has a mustache.

==Activities==
He is one of the nobles present at the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] meeting on the border of Murandy and [[Andor]]. He appears uneasy about the prospect of a battle between Aes Sedai on Murandian soil.

Egwene observes him standing much too close to [[Halima Saranov]] and staring down her dress. She only pays him half a mind, though smiles up at him warmly.
